title: Causal motor-population forecasting
disposition_reason: The complete 574-query future-count scorer and submitted-programme lifecycle are now present as source. The programme freezes candidate code, exposes only the original public operands, and closes candidate resources before the separate unchanged grader. Authentic input, temporal-preprocessing and native runtime qualification remain separate; condition labels and retrospective movement alignment still limit causal interpretation.

scientific_target.question: From 137 observed units before+450 ms and permitted trial-condition context, how accurately can a fixed method predict all 182 units over the following 200 ms?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed integer spike counts for all 182 units in 40 future 5 ms bins, relative edges 450…645 ms.
scientific_target.answer_origin: MC_Maze Jenkins 2009-09-25 NWB future spikes, with evaluation future targets separately held by the operator.
scientific_target.case_unit: One reach trial containing a complete past window and future prediction horizon.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One macaque/session;574 trials are nested observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Past-only prediction within the supplied preprocessed, movement-aligned observation clock; this tests temporal forecast dependence, not a perturbation or an online onset detector.
exclusions: Interventional causality or causal biological mechanism.
Pure neural-only inference when condition IDs are supplied.
Unseen animal or untouched target evaluation.

inputs: 1721 training trials with observed and withheld past counts and their future counts.
574 query trials with 137 held-in units over[-250,+450)ms; trial_type/trial_version condition context explicitly permitted.
forbidden_inputs: All query bins at/after+450 ms, query withheld-unit past counts, raw NWB and private future targets.
Stored reference predictions, prior private grades and outcome-adaptive selection.
observation_contract.case_identity: All 574 public eval_trial_ids and 182 forecast_unit_ids, panel_fingerprint and exact 450,455,…645 ms grid; scorer permits ID-aligned reordering. Source checkout does not supply actual packet identities.
observation_contract.split: 1721 whole training trials to 574 exposed development trials; supervised tuning only within whole training trials. Any unsupervised query adaptation must be declared. Source condition support is not a held-condition generalization test.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete 574×40×182 future values; no held-in-only or favorable-trial score. One shared Jenkins source with 017/019; former official test targets are also now public.

primary.name: joint_forward_bits_per_spike
primary.aggregation: Pooled likelihood improvement across all 182 forecast units,574 trials and 40 bins, normalized by observed total spikes.
primary.rationale: The forecast target is future measured spikes across both held-in and held-out populations; evaluation mean is only the null normalization.

secondary: Signed score differences for every frozen reference, retaining original negative and outcome-informed follow-up controls.
Forecast-horizon and unit-group diagnostics; matched within-condition neural shuffle needed for incremental neural information.

comparators.name: global_rate_and_condition_time
comparators.inputs: Training counts and allowed condition/time context.
comparators.procedure: Original fixed global-rate and condition/time comparators; keep continuous signed comparisons.

comparators.name: pooled_condition_and_selected_ridge
comparators.inputs: Training-only labels; pooled condition context or past activity plus condition.
comparators.procedure: Historical version 2 training-only fivefold follow-up is outcome-informed and exposed. Retain both; pooled-condition is stronger in the recorded local development comparison, not a new protected baseline.

nuisance_controls: Prohibit future bins and noncausal filtering across the+450 ms cutoff.
Match condition labels across all methods; compare intact past activity to within-condition shuffled history.
Keep all reference outcomes and exposure chronology; do not select only the weakest comparator.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired complete-trial/block summaries within one session; do not use neurons/bins as independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Validate complete 574×40×182 float32/64 rates, exact future clock, units and IDs before targets. Rates must be finite and strictly positive; all-zero target totals remain undefined. Negative gains are valid, not rejected.

implementation.scorer_target: Joint future measured spike counts; not author-table reconstruction. Current scorer accepts arbitrary prediction arrays and separately evaluates fixed references.
implementation.delivered_scope: Existing numerical scorer plus submitted-program-v1 source for one frozen programme over all 1,721 training trials and 574 queries, with complete 574 x 40 x 182 predictions and all five signed reference comparisons. Operator-provisioned inputs, image and boundary approvals are not bundled or newly qualified.
missing: Authenticate the exact three original public operands and private scorer inputs; qualify temporal preprocessing and source identity without treating this historical packet as the separate causal-packet-v1 projection.

Qualify the submitted-program-v1 candidate/holder and separate original-grader lifecycle, platform compatibility, forced-stop recovery, exact image/source boundary and complete cumulative resource allocation.
Freeze and independently inspect candidate fitting/selection and any declared query adaptation; complete-output checks do not prove the scientific training policy.
Execute matched neural-dependence controls on a prospectively declared evaluation before incremental-information claims. Direct, viewer and case-adaptive investigator transports remain undelivered.
implementation.execution_evidence: Legacy manifest records local scorer/programme software qualification and zero LLM attempts for that qualification; prior reference outcomes are exposed development results, not new trials or present deployment proof. The later submitted-program-v1 package documents generated source/transport controls only; they neither execute authentic packets or candidates nor transfer the legacy runtime qualification to this route.

direct_observation.representation: Proposed per-trial numerical counts or fixed raster with all 40×182 positive future expected counts; no no-tools participant transport is supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Any future direct arm must receive exactly the selected permitted observation and calibrated units, with no decoder, Python, source lookup, target or score access.
missing: Freeze a feasible complete per-case observation and response representation without silently changing the target.
Deliver and qualify a no-tools transport and complete answer collector before a direct-understanding claim.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed raster/time-window inspection of the same selected neural observations; no viewer is delivered for this registration.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only admitted rendered views; raw numerical/model operations would belong to the tool-assisted condition. Query targets and source identities remain inaccessible.
missing: Implement task-specific renderer, restricted actions and complete responses.
Verify rendered observations preserve required time/unit information and run a separately identified viewer evaluation.

tool_assisted.representation: The restored submitted-programme and operator utilities can produce complete submissions, but no case-adaptive participant investigation loop is supplied for this condition.
tool_assisted.boundary: Match observations, calibration, decoder access and cumulative compute against the fixed programme; freeze shared preparation, reset case state and prevent target/score feedback.

frozen_program.representation: One precommitted Python programme receives the original complete historical training/query packet and returns all 574 x 40 x 182 positive expected counts through submitted-program-v1.
frozen_program.boundary: Only past.npz, training_future.npz and public_manifest.json are public operands. Candidate code is frozen before their release; query targets and scorer/reference files never enter candidate mounts. The same entire query batch and declared training policy apply; output validation cannot certify fitting provenance.

A prospective complete candidate run and matched-method/scientific review; source controls are not current programme performance.
